evidence: The Company utilizes AI and machine learning technologies in various aspects of its operations, including production planning, predictive maintenance, quality control, and supply chain optimization.
The Company's ability to remain competitive depends on its capacity to adapt to rapid technological changes and successfully integrate new technologies into its operations.
AI systems may produce inaccurate or biased outputs, fail to integrate effectively with existing processes, or experience technical malfunctions.
the Company's reliance on AI-driven automation may increase vulnerability to cybersecurity threats, data breaches, or unauthorized access to proprietary information.
ai_positioning.summary: MHK intègre l'IA et le machine learning dans ses opérations internes (planification, maintenance prédictive, contrôle qualité, optimisation supply chain) mais adopte une posture prudente face aux risques technologiques, de cybersécurité et réglementaires.
